description: This file defines an abstract class for browser or device identification within the Zend Framework's HTTP UserAgent component. It includes methods for parsing user agent strings, managing device features, and providing device capabilities.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_AbstractDevice
classes.description: An abstract class modeling a user agent device/browser, providing parsing, feature detection, and capability reporting.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Abstract method to get the device type identifier.

methods.name: hasFeature
methods.description: Checks if a specific feature is present in the device.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific feature.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Sets a feature and optionally associates it with a group.

methods.name: setGroup
methods.description: Assigns a feature to a group category.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns all features associated with a given group.

methods.name: getAllFeatures
methods.description: Returns all features detected for the device.

methods.name: getAllGroups
methods.description: Returns all feature groups.

methods.name: getImageFormatSupport
methods.description: Returns supported image formats.

methods.name: getMaxImageHeight
methods.description: Returns maximum image height supported (null if undefined).

methods.name: getMaxImageWidth
methods.description: Returns maximum image width supported (null if undefined).

methods.name: getPhysicalScreenHeight
methods.description: Returns physical screen height (null if undefined).

methods.name: getPhysicalScreenWidth
methods.description: Returns physical screen width (null if undefined).

methods.name: getPreferredMarkup
methods.description: Returns preferred markup format (e.g., xhtml).

methods.name: getXhtmlSupportLevel
methods.description: Returns level of XHTML support.

methods.name: hasFlashSupport
methods.description: Indicates if Flash support is available.

methods.name: hasPdfSupport
methods.description: Indicates if PDF support is available.

methods.name: hasPhoneNumber
methods.description: Indicates if device has an associated phone number.

methods.name: httpsSupport
methods.description: Indicates if HTTPS is supported.

methods.name: getBrowser
methods.description: Returns the detected browser name.

methods.name: getBrowserVersion
methods.description: Returns the detected browser version.

methods.name: getUserAgent
methods.description: Returns the user agent string.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Returns supported image types.

methods.name: setBrowser
methods.description: Sets the browser name.

methods.name: setBrowserVersion
methods.description: Sets the browser version.

methods.name: setUserAgent
methods.description: Sets the user agent string.

methods.name: setImages
methods.description: Sets the supported image formats.

methods.name: _matchAgentAgainstSignatures
methods.description: Matches a user agent string against a list of signatures.
